newsitem.title: FRANCE: SUEZ sees rise in 1996 pre-exceptional.
newsitem.headline: SUEZ sees rise in 1996 pre-exceptional.

text.p: Cie de Suez expects to see a rise in its pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit in 1996, chairman Gerard Mestrallet told reporters on Wednesday.
"The group's current (pre-tax, pre-exceptional) profit will be up from last year on a comparable basis," Mestrallet said at a news conference.
Suez earlier posted a pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit of 1,186 million francs in the first half of 1996 against a profit of 910 million francs at the halfway stage last year.
Suez in April posted a 1995 pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit (group share) of 1,622 million francs against 3,391 million francs the year before.
